title: Intro to Programming: Logic Building
prompt: Write a program that takes an integer array from the user and finds the second largest number without using any built-in sorting functions. Upload your clean source code file (.py, .cpp, or .c).
questions: 1. What is the difference between compiler and interpreter in terms of code execution?
2. Explain how a recursive function utilizes the system stack memory.

title: Data Structures & Algorithms: Queue Implementation
prompt: Implement a standard Queue data structure using two Stacks (LIFO pattern). Ensure both Enqueue and Dequeue operations are handled efficiently. Upload your source code file.
questions: 1. Compare the time complexities of Quick Sort and Merge Sort in their worst-case scenarios.
2. Why is a Linked List preferred over a Dynamic Array when frequent insertions occur at the beginning?

title: Web Development: Responsive Layout & DOM
prompt: Create a semantic HTML5 page layout featuring a grid-based card view that dynamically updates its content using JavaScript DOM manipulation. Zip your HTML, CSS, and JS files together and upload.
questions: 1. What is the difference between localStorage and sessionStorage in browser storage?
2. Explain the CSS Box Model and how box-sizing: border-box alters it.

title: JavaScript Mastery: Asynchronous JS Task
prompt: Write a script that fetches user profile data from a placeholder API using Async/Await, handles network errors gracefully with try-catch, and maps the data to the UI. Submit your .js script.
questions: 1. What is the difference between '==' and '===' operators in JavaScript?
2. Explain the concept of JavaScript Closures with a practical use-case.

title: Artificial Intelligence: State Space Search
prompt: Implement the A* Search Algorithm to find the shortest path on a given grid map with static obstacles. Submit your Python script or Jupyter Notebook (.ipynb) containing the heuristic function logic.
questions: 1. What is the main difference between Informed (Heuristic) and Uninformed Search strategies?
2. Briefly explain the concept of Turing Test and its significance in AI evaluation.

title: Machine Learning: Linear Regression Model
prompt: Load a sample housing dataset, perform basic data preprocessing (handling missing values, feature scaling), and train a Linear Regression model. Upload your Jupyter Notebook (.ipynb) with evaluation metrics (MSE/R2 Score).
questions: 1. Explain the fundamental difference between Supervised and Unsupervised Learning.
2. What is Overfitting in Machine Learning, and how can regularization methods help mitigate it?
